name: aiPHeed E40 binary food-stress label (exploratory)
rule: HIGH (1) if sws_hi AND (cpi_hi OR gap_hi) in quarter q AND in quarter q-1 (sustain = 2); LOW (0) otherwise; no label where the quarter has no approved SWS round (never zero-filled)

signals.sws_hi: Balance Luzon hunger H_q > P60 of H over the frozen window
signals.cpi_hi: province food CPI YoY (PSA published, quarter mean) > P60 of that province over the window
signals.gap_hi: food minus headline CPI YoY > P60 of that province over the window
signals.cpi_rel: food YoY minus the five-province mean (reported; ranking and ties)

selection: researcher's choice (2026-10-15) after the P60-P85 grid; amended gates: 5-30% overall HIGH share of the development sample; 40% per-year cap only on years with >= 3 development quarters
variant_sws_21_1: 21.1% = SWS 2020 annual average hunger, as supplied by the researcher (2026-10-15); not verified in this run. It is a pre-2021 statistic used as a threshold, an explicit exception to the study-window rule, so it is reported as a variant only and never selected as the primary label.
training_use_of_burn_in_labels: labels of 2021-2022 quarters (computed with the frozen thresholds) are used as training targets only, never scored

data.cpi: PSA OpenStat 0012M4ACP23 published monthly YoY, All items and 01.1 Food, 2021-01..2026-09

not: not a validated measure of food insecurity; indicative, not an official classification
